# v0.13.0 generation baseline

These tables were generated by `madcats.py` from tag `v0.13.0`
(commit `302541a215f9105901db73fbb980a7d70e4dde56`), using the checked-in `examples/madcats-demo` data.
They are frozen outputs, not regenerated by the implementation under test.

Commands, with the v0.13.0 script saved as `madcats_v013.py`:

```bash
python3 madcats_v013.py design --primers examples/madcats-demo/primers.csv \
  --probe-design examples/madcats-demo/probe_design.tsv --output tags.csv
python3 madcats_v013.py generate --fastq-dir examples/madcats-demo/fastq \
  --reference-tags tags.csv --sample-lookup examples/madcats-demo/sample_names.csv \
  --jobs 1 --gapped-rescue on --output gapped_on.csv
python3 madcats_v013.py generate --fastq-dir examples/madcats-demo/fastq \
  --reference-tags tags.csv --sample-lookup examples/madcats-demo/sample_names.csv \
  --jobs 1 --gapped-rescue off --output gapped_off.csv
```

The comparison includes every row, category, sequence, annotation and per-sample count.
No vendor preamble was requested, so version/provenance differences do not affect the files.
The example has no tile families; tiled panels need `--tile-groups off` for the old assignment
behaviour. This is regression coverage of one simulated panel, not validation of every real panel.
